content_sections.heading: MPMMCC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MPMMCC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MPMMCC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: MPMMCC Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Data Entry Operator, 1 for Clinical Research Coordinator and 1 for Nurse.

content_sections.heading: MPMMCC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Data Entry Operator: Graduate degree in a relevant field with a minimum six-month computer course from a recognized institute or MS-CIT certificate mandatory. Clinical Research Coordinator: B.Sc./ B. Pharm (PG Diploma in Clinical Research is mandatory) / M.Sc. / M. Pharm (PG Diploma in Clinical Research is Mandatory) / M.Sc. in Clinical Research or Equivalent Qualification. Nurse: General Nursing & Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing. Candidates should be eligible to register with Indian Nursing Council / State Nursing Council. Hepatitis Vaccination should be completed.

content_sections.text: Data Entry Operator: Rs. 25000 Per Month Clinical Research Coordinator: Rs. 27000 to 35000 Per Month Nurse: Rs. 32000 to 35000 Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MPMMCC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by MPMMCC?
faq.answer: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC) has announced a total of 4 vacancies for various project posts through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for MPMMCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post is Rs. 25000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Clinical Research Coordinator position?
faq.answer: For the Clinical Research Coordinator post, candidates need a B.Sc./B. Pharm (with PG Diploma in Clinical Research) or M.Sc./M. Pharm (with PG Diploma in Clinical Research) or M.Sc. in Clinical Research or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates, as well as for General/OBC candidates, for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in date for the Nurse position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Nurse position is scheduled for 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these project posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-In Interview. A Written Test may be conducted if there are more candidates, followed by a Skill Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location of MPMMCC?
faq.answer: MPMMCC is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.

faq.question: Q10. Are the posts contractual or permanent?
faq.answer: The posts announced under this recruitment are contractual in nature.
